# Madju Batik

> Batik fabric shop at Jl. Sulawesi No. 19, Dauh Puri Kangin, Denpasar Barat, Bali 80112, Indonesia, across the road from Pasar Badung. Also known as Maju Batik, Madju Batik Bali and Toko Madju. Sells Bali batik cotton, batik rayon and rayon voile by the metre, ready quilting packs, and bulk orders from 45 metres per print. Ships worldwide by air or by sea. Orders by WhatsApp: +62 878-6223-6936. Open Monday to Saturday, 09.00–17.00; closed Sunday. Fixed prices.

## Pages

- [Madju Batik shop](https://madjubatik.com/): what we sell, ready packs, bulk orders, questions, opening hours and how to find the shop
- [Bali batik for quilters](https://madjubatik.com/quilting/): jelly roll strips 2.5″ × 44″, fat quarter cuts 45 × 55 cm, squares 25 × 25 cm, minis 5″ × 5″, scraps, and how to order from abroad
